doc: Roles, not model ids. Each agent names a role; a profile maps every role to a model, a person picks the profile, and their machine may override roles in ~/.config/opencode/models.local.json. bin/models resolves them into one file per role, which opencode.json reads through {file:}.

roles.lead: plans, dispatches, reviews and lands; the top-level session
roles.implementor: writes one bounded task in its own worktree
roles.reviewer: fresh-context read-only review of a diff
roles.advisor: read-only consult when a named trigger fires
